Calculate each case type’s filing-fee collections, including the 6% surcharge and electronic-filing credits.

- Civil:  
  \(420 \times 85 \times 1.06 = \$37{,}842\)  
  Electronic credits: \(420 \times 70\% \times \$5 = \$1{,}470\)  
  Net: \(\$37{,}842-\$1{,}470=\$36{,}372\)

- Family law:  
  \(175 \times 120 \times 1.06 = \$22{,}260\)  
  Electronic credits: \(175 \times 40\% \times \$5 = \$350\)  
  Net: \(\$21{,}910\)

- Probate:  
  \(60 \times 210 \times 1.06 = \$13{,}356\)  
  Electronic credits: \(60 \times 25\% \times \$5 = \$75\)  
  Net: \(\$13{,}281\)

Total filing-fee collections:

\[
36{,}372+21{,}910+13{,}281=\$71{,}563
\]

The courthouse retains 82%:

\[
71{,}563 \times 0.82=\$58{,}781.66
\]

Rounded to the nearest dollar, the courthouse retained:

\[
\boxed{\$58{,}782}
\]

The $9,400 passport-services revenue is excluded.
